description: Record a stock count, add stock, or remove stock at a managed warehouse — the Inventory page's Adjust, Add and Remove actions. Each line is one item at one location: mode=count sets that location's on-hand to the counted quantity; mode=add adds units at a unit cost (defaults to the item's cost); mode=remove takes units out (damage, shrinkage, samples) and posts the inventory-decrease accounting entry. Added stock releases backordered sales-order lines. Tracked items need their lot, expiry or serials. The preview shows each location's on-hand and available before and after. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt. For opening-stock seeding use set_inventory_levels; to receive a purchase order use receive_purchase_order. Max 100 lines per call.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants: confines SKU/UPC matching to that client's items. Client-pinned credentials omit this.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

lines.description: Stock lines (max 100). All lines commit together or not at all.

location.description: Location name, code, barcode or id inside the warehouse. Optional: count and add use the item's default location; remove uses the only location holding the item.

mode.description: count = set the on-hand at the location to the counted quantity; add = add units; remove = take units out (damage, shrinkage, samples).

quantity.description: For count: the counted on-hand (>= 0). For add/remove: the number of units (> 0).

serials.description: Serial numbers, for serial-tracked items (one per unit).

unitCost.description: Unit cost for added units (add only). Defaults to the item's current cost.

upc.description: Item UPC/barcode, used when SKU is absent or unmatched.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

warehouseId.description: Internal warehouse id (GUID) from list_warehouses. May be omitted when the tenant has exactly one Internal warehouse.

name: adjust_stock
title: Adjust Stock
